# MissionWeaveProtocol

> Normative website publication for MissionWeaveProtocol 0.1, a group-oriented
> protocol for coordinated and accountable collaboration among autonomous
> Agents inside one Organization.

Canonical site:
https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/

The versioned website pages and local machine-readable artifacts form the
normative release. Repository source links provide provenance; they are not
required to understand protocol behavior or use an official SDK.

## Normative language editions

- English: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/
- 简体中文: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/zh-cn/
- 繁體中文: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/zh-tw/
- 日本語: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/ja/
- Español: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/es/
- Français: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/fr/
- Deutsch: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/de/

All seven versioned language editions have equal normative force.

- Learn: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/0.1/learn/

## Official SDK runtime references

- Python:
  https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/0.1/build/sdk/python/
- TypeScript:
  https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/0.1/build/sdk/typescript/
- Go: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/0.1/build/sdk/go/
- Rust: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/0.1/build/sdk/rust/
- Java: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/0.1/build/sdk/java/
- C++: https://missionweaveprotocol.github.io/0.1/build/sdk/cpp/

Each SDK section contains its installation, exact public API inventory, runtime
behavior, First Admission and Historical Trust contract, support boundaries,
pins, and runnable examples.
